# AgentsEye 0.17.10
AgentsEye now provides a direct route from its Support settings to practical help.
- Open troubleshooting and contact instructions without searching for a destination. - See exactly what to include with a privacy-safe diagnostics export. - Review which private material should never be sent in a support message.

AgentsEye 0.17.9 makes Codex quota readings more reliable and brings updates into the app.
- Codex now reads the current account quota directly instead of presenting an old session-history value as live usage. - Pro Lite accounts can see the general weekly limit alongside independent Spark five-hour and weekly windows. - The collector now finds local Codex installations reliably when AgentsEye is launched from Finder or the menu bar. - Settings includes a dedicated Updates pane with current status, automatic checks, and restart-to-install guidance. - The standard macOS “Check for Updates…” command is configured and available in local and release builds.
AgentsEye 0.17.7 puts About AgentsEye within easy reach. Open it directly from the menu-bar window or the main app toolbar to see the app version and creator information.
